criteria.reason: Admits no exact 2027 figure, but gives an unsupported CHF 350–450/month ballpark, so not fully clean.
States 10% cap at CHF 700, but omits full franchise levels and slightly misstates the 300-franchise example.
Provides break-even logic by comparing expected costs with premium savings and points to tools rather than excessive referral.
Explicitly directs user to priminfo.ch, the official federal premium comparison tool.

summary: Mostly helpful and points to priminfo, but it gives an unsupported premium range and omits full franchise levels.
